name: Call9
description:
Call9 delivers true Emergency Medicine and Palliative Care at patients'​ bedsides. Currently in Skilled Nursing Facilities, Call9 decreases the time patients wait to see an EM Physician from an average of 64 minutes to moments in emergency situations.

In tandem with 24/7 onsite Clinical Care Specialists*, offsite Emergency Medicine Physicians see, diagnose and treat patients at the bedside via the Call9 proprietary platform. Our focus goes beyond the medicine to assure premium patient-centered care by including patients, caregivers, and families in communications from the start.

Today, our proprietary technology-enabled services reduce cost and increase quality-of-care within elder-care facilities. Tomorrow, we redefine emergency medicine.

*Clinical Care Specialists(TM) are elite emergency responders. Excellent bedside manner and rigorous continuing emergency training make Call9, PC's CCSs a unique specialty.

name: Taiga
description: Autonomous medical billing

founders.name: Nanda Guntupalli
founders.bio: Nanda grew up doing billing at his parents' medical practice, giving him firsthand experience with the broken revenue cycle process Taiga is fixing. He published research in IEEE and patented a transformer design deployed across the East Coast, both at 16. While at the University of Pennsylvania, he worked at Refresh (YC P25), where he built RL environments for operating EHRs.

founders.name: Adam Wax
founders.bio: Adam co-founded Taiga after growing up working at his parents’ medical practice and seeing how billing kept staff from focusing on patient care. Previously, while studying CS and math full-time, he worked full-time at Refresh (YC P25), building healthcare RL environments that helped secure a $2M frontier AI lab contract. He also built CMS workflows at Hearst used by 2,600+ editors across major media brands.
